news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.03 (vs ₹3.95 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.03 (up from ₹3.95 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.55b (up 22% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹458.0m (up 27% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 18% (in line with FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹2.50
news.body: Dividend of ₹2.50 is 25% higher than last year. Ex-date: 15th July 2026 Payment date: 29th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 2.4%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.6%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (51% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (60% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 15% per year over the past 5 years and payments have been stable during that time. Earnings per share has grown by 32% over the last 5 years. Unless this trend reverses, it should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited Recommends Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026, Payable on or from August 4, 2026
news.body: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited announced that at the board meeting held on May 15, 2026, the Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of INR 2.5/- per equity share (25%) of INR 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, subject to the approval of the Members at the upcoming Annual General Meeting ("AGM") of the Company to be held on July 30, 2026. Pursuant to Regulation 42 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Company has fixed July 15, 2026, as the Record Date for determining the entitlement of Members' to receive Dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹9.01b (US$99.1m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
